title: 专题：平台定制包和内核白名单（系统应用里新建的共用视图、报表有处可放；「用户」「组织」可以加自定义字段、表单和布局）（暂停）
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

③ maintainer direct order · Source: maintainer, 2026-11-28, project thread "评估建工作区定制包" (words below). ④ coordination parent: not dispatched itself; children are split and filed when the topic is picked up. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: area:package · parent (no type) · evidence: read on origin/main 581ae76a (`19.0.0-next.2`). Sizes below are estimates from reading, not measurements.
Restart-when: `npm view @objectstack/runtime dist-tags.latest` answers 19.x (19.0.0 or later). At filing it answers 18.6.0; next is 19.0.0-next.2. On restart the seat asks the maintainer once whether to open M0.
Dedupe: searched `"platform pair"`, `"kernel whitelist"`, `内核白名单`, `平台定制包`, `"com.objectstack.kernel.custom"`, `"sys_custom"` (issues, open and closed). Hits: #37424 (the Studio topic, open; its phase 4 is where this came up), #37453 (census, closed), #29594 (the two rulings, closed), #31014 (the ADR-0146 D3 amendment, closed), #29567 (closed). None carries the platform pair or the whitelist as work.

## 维护者速读

- **要解决什么**：系统自带的那一套（设置、账户、Studio 和所有平台对象）没有自己的定制包。所以在设置里新建大家共用的列表视图或报表没有地方放；「用户」「组织」也加不了自定义字段。
- **已经裁过什么**：11 月 6 日你同意内核整套共用一个「平台定制包」，并说「内核白名单，可以下一版本再处理，首批名单建议：Users、Organizations」。v19 就是那个下一版。
- **现状**：平台定制包这一版不建，创建入口对内核包直接拒绝。第 4 阶段 Q-b 因此先按「拒绝并指路」处理（你 11 月 28 日定的）。
- **分几步**：先开包加窄口（只收系统应用里新建的共用视图和报表，5 到 6 张卡，不碰身份表）；再把已有的系统项定制迁进来并关掉豁免；最后开「用户」「组织」白名单。完整做完估 9 到 11 张卡。
- **为什么暂停**：v19 正在准备发布。这件事几乎全是「放开」，不需要卡在大版本上；首批名单又是平台保护最严的两张表，不适合在发版前动。
- **什么时候再提**：v19.0.0 正式版发布后，席位来问你一次要不要开工。逾 30 天不续，按规则关单。
- **要你做什么**：现在无。发 v19 前有一件小事另行处理：ADR-0146 写的「下一版开白名单」要补一句注明改到 19.x，由你合并。

## Maintainer's words (2026-11-28, Asia/Singapore)

- 「用 fable 评估真建「工作区定制包」的合理性和工作量」
- 「如果不卡平台定制包，合理的应该怎样」
- 「一、不开工作区定制包，「没地方放」的情形怎么处理，就按照你的方案」
- 「内核白名单，现在已经准备发 v19了，你现在建议处理吗」
- 「评估一下具体的工作量」
- 「立专题卡，暂停」

Earlier rulings this topic carries out (records on #29594): 6691022506 (「① 定制单位 = App；同意」; the premise 「内核作为平台套件、版本随运行时、总是全套安装」) and 6691217245 (「内核白名单，可以下一版本再处理，首批名单建议：Users、Organizations；其他同意。」).

## Business reason

- **Who.** An administrator who wants a shared list view of Users in Setup (active users, administrators), and a customer who needs their own fields on Users or Organizations (an employee number, a cost centre).
- **Today.** A shared view or report made in a system app has no package to live in: phase 4 of #37424 refuses it and points to My views or a business app. No kernel object takes a `__c` field.
- **Pull.** No named customer. The examples store 0 such rows; deployments are unmeasured (carrier: cloud). That is why the topic is parked and not scheduled.
- **Not this topic.** A workspace-wide catch-all package. The maintainer declined it on 2026-11-28; ADR-0070 D1 and D6 and decision 11 of #37424 stand.

## Readings (at `581ae76a`)

- **The decision exists.** ADR-0146 D3, lines 549–584: one platform pair, `com.objectstack.kernel.custom`, namespace `sys_custom`, range `^<major>` of the platform version in `engines.platform`. Line 572: "No kernel object is customizable in this version … so no platform pair is created in this version. The next version opens the first kernel whitelist, Users and Organizations only … `__c` fields, forms, views and page layouts". Two prerequisites are named there: a declared `isSystem` reading in place of the `sys_` prefix heuristics, and `customizable` judged at every write into the platform pair.
- **The door refuses.** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-customization-package.ts:383–389` answers `409` for a kernel package. `packages/metadata-core/src/customization-pair-lookup.ts` leaves a kernel package unresolved ("its pair would be the platform pair, which no door creates in this version").
- **The three system apps are kernel packages.** `packages/apps/{setup,account,studio}/src/index.ts`, `scope: 'system'`. The console already asks the ensure door before it falls back to a package-less save (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:202–222`).
- **Readers of the pairing.** 14 non-test files call `pairOf(`, 24 call `isPairOf(` or `pairsOf(`, 3 call `kernelPackageScope(`.
- **Users and Organizations are identity tables.** `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:105–122` and `sys-organization.object.ts:22–51`: `isSystem: true`, `managedBy: 'better-auth'`, `protection.lock: 'full'` ("schema must not drift", ADR-0010 §3.7). A user-context update may touch `{name, image, locale}` only (ADR-0092 D2; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/identity-write-guard.ts`). The platform's own extension fields are a hard-coded list (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/managed-extension-fields.ts`, ADR-0105 D7).
- **`isSystem` already exists** on the object schema (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:4147`), so the prerequisite is the heuristics, not the key.
- **The `sys_` prefix heuristics.** `hasPlatformObjectPrefix`: 18 non-test files, 36 sites. Literal `startsWith('sys_')`: 40 files, 45 sites. They matter only if a customer object can be named `sys_custom_<short>`.
- **Migration.** `os migrate packageless-overlays` exists and leaves kernel rows where they are (ADR-0146 D11, merge question 10). No command re-identifies a per-package kernel pair an earlier version created (merge question 12); such a pair holds `sys_custom` and would block the platform pair.
- **Studio.** The package switcher filters kernel packages out (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioPackageSwitcher.tsx:76–87`), so the platform pair has no row today. Kernel checks in the console: 4 non-test files, 12 sites.

## Milestones

Only the current milestone becomes cards. None is filed while the topic is on hold.

| Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| M0 readings and rulings | Probe: does an object extension land on a `protection.lock: 'full'` object today | — | area:package |
| M0 | Probe: a report saved into a package that depends on no business app, reading a business object (ADR-0150 D3 (c)) | — | area:package |
| M0 | Reading: how many deployments hold a per-package kernel pair (carrier: cloud) | — | area:cloud |
| M0 | Decision card: may the platform pair hold new objects (decides M4); which types the narrow slice admits | — | maintainer |
| M1 narrow slice | ADR-0146 D3 amendment: the platform pair is created, and admits only new shared views and reports made in system apps (Tier H) | M0 | area:package |
| M1 | Platform pair identity and creation: `appOf` / `pairOf` for a kernel package, the ensure door's kernel branch, `engines.platform`, the install predicate (contract tier) | ADR amendment | area:package |
| M1 | Write gate into the platform pair: admit new `view` and `report`, refuse the rest with a reason; the kernel overlay close stays where it is (contract tier) | identity card | area:package |
| M1 | Console: a row for the platform pair in Studio's switcher, the draft bar in system apps counts and publishes it, the "saved outside this app" hint retires for this case | identity card | area:ux |
| M1 | Docs, QA checklist items, dogfood | the above | area:package |
| M2 migrate and close | Move package-less rows over admitted kernel items into the platform pair; re-identify per-package kernel pairs; then close the W3 exemption of #37424 phase 4 | M1 | area:package |
| M3 whitelist | Whitelist declaration and the per-write `customizable` judge (contract tier) | M1 | area:package |
| M3 | `__c` fields on Users and Organizations: ADR-0010 and ADR-0092 amendments, the identity write guard reads pair-declared `__c` fields (contract tier, security) | M0 probe, whitelist card | area:data |
| M3 | Forms, views and page layouts on the two objects; the arrangement keys recognise the platform pair | whitelist card | area:ux |
| M4 only if new objects are admitted | Replace the `sys_` prefix heuristics with the declared `isSystem` reading (2–3 cards) | M0 decision | area:package |

Estimate: M1 is 5–6 cards. M1–M3 are 9–11 cards, 4–5 of them at contract tier, with three ADR amendments for the maintainer to merge. M4 adds 2–3.

## Relation to #37424 phase 4

- Q-b is answered C for now (the maintainer, 2026-11-28): a shared view or report made in a system app is refused with a pointer. C stores no loose row, so M1 changes that refusal to "saved into the platform pair" with nothing to move.
- The kernel close keeps its W3 exemption (an overlay of a kernel item) until M2.
- Not asked here: Q-a, Q-d, Q-f, Q-g.

## Owed before 19.0.0, outside this hold

ADR-0146:574 says "The next version opens the first kernel whitelist". If 19.0.0 ships without it, that sentence needs a dated note moving the whitelist to 19.x. It is Tier H, so the maintainer merges it. A comment on this card records it when it lands.
